neighbours.label: 'already' asserting that a current state is sufficient or already holds (already up to date, already doing a good job, already a list, fine the way you are), vs temporal 'already' about an event that happened earlier
fire: Relax, your phone already has the latest version installed.
Honestly, you're already a wonderful parent to those kids.
Skip this step if the column is already sorted.
The app told me my drivers were already up to date.
You already have everything you need to pass the exam.
Return early when the cache is already populated.
Your essay is already good enough to submit as it is.
Don't change a thing, the garden already looks perfect.
quiet: By the time we arrived, the concert had already started.
The bus had already gone when she reached the stop.
Your phone needs a new version before the app can work.
The column must be sorted before the search can run.
He had already eaten lunch when his friends called.
The guests had already left by midnight.
Your essay needs a lot more work before you submit it.
The snow had already melted when spring came.

predictions: Reassurances or checks that a state already holds reach 0.3-0.65; temporal 'already' (had already left) and statements of inadequacy stay under 0.1.
notes: Card: already up to date, already doing a good enough job, you are already, just the way they are, you look fine, isn't already idempotent. Probe: already up to date 0.626, already doing a great job 0.509, already a list 0.522, look fine 0.283, the way she is 0.270; had already left 0.021, needs an update 0.033.
